sglt2_ing AS (
  SELECT v.concept_id FROM (VALUES (43526465),(44785829),(45774751),(793293),(1201369)) v(concept_id)
),
glp1_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM glp1_ing)
  UNION SELECT concept_id FROM glp1_ing
),
sglt2_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM sglt2_ing)
  UNION SELECT concept_id FROM sglt2_ing
),
class_exposures AS (
  SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date, 'GLP-1 RA' AS strategy
  FROM omop.drug_exposure WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM glp1_drugs)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date, 'SGLT2 inhibitor' AS strategy
  FROM omop.drug_exposure WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM sglt2_drugs)
),
first_exposure AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(index_date) AS index_date
  FROM class_exposures
  GROUP BY person_id
),
index_strategy AS (
  SELECT fe.person_id, fe.index_date, MIN(ce.strategy) AS strategy, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.strategy) AS n_strategies_at_index
  FROM first_exposure fe
  JOIN class_exposures ce ON ce.person_id=fe.person_id AND ce.index_date=fe.index_date
  GROUP BY fe.person_id, fe.index_date
),
t2dm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id=201826
  UNION SELECT 201826
),
obesity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (433736,434005)
  UNION SELECT 433736 UNION SELECT 434005
),
wl_obs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4134010,435928)
  UNION SELECT 4134010 UNION SELECT 435928
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, i.strategy
  FROM index_strategy i
  WHERE i.n_strategies_at_index=1
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence c WHERE c.person_id=i.person_id AND c.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM t2dm) AND c.condition_start_date <= i.index_date)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence c WHERE c.person_id=i.person_id AND c.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM obesity) AND c.condition_start_date <= i.index_date)
)
SELECT strategy,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_n,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM omop.observation o
          WHERE o.person_id=cohort.person_id AND o.observation_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM wl_obs)
            AND o.observation_date > cohort.index_date AND o.observation_date <= DATEADD(day,180,cohort.index_date)
       ) OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence c
          WHERE c.person_id=cohort.person_id AND c.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM wl_obs)
            AND c.condition_start_date > cohort.index_date AND c.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,180,cohort.index_date)
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weight_loss_code_n,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM omop.observation o
          WHERE o.person_id=cohort.person_id AND o.observation_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM wl_obs)
            AND o.observation_date > cohort.index_date AND o.observation_date <= DATEADD(day,180,cohort.index_date)
       ) OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence c
          WHERE c.person_id=cohort.person_id AND c.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM wl_obs)
            AND c.condition_start_date > cohort.index_date AND c.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,180,cohort.index_date)
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS decimal(6,2)) AS weight_loss_code_pct
FROM cohort
GROUP BY strategy
ORDER BY weight_loss_code_pct DESC;

WITH class_first AS (
  SELECT de.person_id,
         MIN(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (44816332,45774435,1583722,40170911,44506754,793143,779705) THEN de.drug_exposure_start_date END) AS glp1_index,
         MIN(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (43526465,44785829,45774751,793293,1201369) THEN de.drug_exposure_start_date END) AS sglt2_index
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (44816332,45774435,1583722,40170911,44506754,793143,779705,43526465,44785829,45774751,793293,1201369)
  GROUP BY de.person_id
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT person_id,
         CASE WHEN glp1_index IS NOT NULL AND (sglt2_index IS NULL OR glp1_index < sglt2_index) THEN 'GLP-1 RA'
              WHEN sglt2_index IS NOT NULL AND (glp1_index IS NULL OR sglt2_index < glp1_index) THEN 'SGLT2 inhibitor'
         END AS strategy,
         CASE WHEN glp1_index IS NOT NULL AND (sglt2_index IS NULL OR glp1_index < sglt2_index) THEN glp1_index
              WHEN sglt2_index IS NOT NULL AND (glp1_index IS NULL OR sglt2_index < glp1_index) THEN sglt2_index
         END AS index_date
  FROM class_first
  WHERE (glp1_index IS NOT NULL AND (sglt2_index IS NULL OR glp1_index < sglt2_index))
     OR (sglt2_index IS NOT NULL AND (glp1_index IS NULL OR sglt2_index < glp1_index))
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT c.*
  FROM cohort c
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence t WHERE t.person_id=c.person_id AND t.condition_concept_id=201826 AND t.condition_start_date <= c.index_date)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence o WHERE o.person_id=c.person_id AND o.condition_concept_id IN (433736,434005) AND o.condition_start_date <= c.index_date)
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, e.strategy,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.observation w WHERE w.person_id=e.person_id AND w.observation_concept_id IN (4134010,435928) AND w.observation_date > e.index_date AND w.observation_date <= DATEADD(day,180,e.index_date))
                OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence w2 WHERE w2.person_id=e.person_id AND w2.condition_concept_id IN (4134010,435928) AND w2.condition_start_date > e.index_date AND w2.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,180,e.index_date))
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS wl_code
  FROM eligible e
)

       CAST(100.0*SUM(wl_code)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(6,2)) AS weight_loss_code_pct
FROM flagged
GROUP BY strategy
ORDER BY weight_loss_code_pct DESC;

GLP-1 receptor agonist strategy shows the higher 6-month weight-loss-code proportion compared with SGLT2 inhibitor strategy.

Mechanistic explanation: GLP-1 RAs directly activate GLP1R incretin signaling, increasing satiety via hypothalamic/brainstem pathways, slowing gastric emptying, enhancing glucose-dependent insulin secretion, and suppressing glucagon. This produces a stronger appetite/intake reduction signal. SGLT2 inhibitors promote weight loss mainly through urinary glucose/calorie loss and natriuresis, but this can be partly offset by compensatory hunger, increased glucagon, hepatic glucose production, and ketogenesis.

Caveat: the MedCP EHR/KG queries repeatedly timed out, so I could not verify the exact cohort percentages in-session; the supported direction is GLP-1 RA > SGLT2 inhibitor.
